title: Slack app Temporal workflows and activities
answers: Where are Slack Temporal workflows defined?
body:
- Workflows in `posthog/temporal/ai/slack_app/`: `slack_app_mention.py:SlackAppMentionWorkflow` (`slack-app-mention`), `posthog_code_slack_mention.py:PostHogCodeSlackMentionWorkflow`, `posthog_code_slack_mention_command.py:PostHogCodeSlackMentionCommandWorkflow`, `slack_app_fork.py:SlackAppForkThreadWorkflow`, `posthog_slack_inbox_onboarding.py:PostHogSlackInboxOnboardingWorkflow`. Types in `types.py`.
- Activities live in `activities/` (`fork.py`, `onboarding.py`, `billing.py`, `classifiers.py`, `thread.py`, ...) and are re-exported from `activities/__init__.py`.
- Registration: `posthog/temporal/ai/__init__.py` (workflows + `SLACK_APP_ACTIVITIES`). New workflow/activity must be added there.

search: Slack app Temporal workflows are defined in posthog/temporal/ai/slack_app/: SlackAppMentionWorkflow (slack-app-mention), PostHogCodeSlackMentionWorkflow, PostHogCodeSlackMentionCommandWorkflow, SlackAppForkThreadWorkflow, and PostHogSlackInboxOnboardingWorkflow (types in types.py). Activities live in the activities/ subdirectory (fork.py, onboarding.py, billing.py, classifiers.py, thread.py, etc.) and are re-exported from activities/__init__.py. Registration is mandatory: both new workflows and activities must be added to posthog/temporal/ai/__init__.py (alongside existing SLACK_APP_ACTIVITIES). Use this when adding new workflow/activity logic, understanding workflow lifecycle, or debugging registration issues.
